Breakpoints._Preset: Normal long-rebirth PUSH (auto-installed). One long run to build max stats, then kill the titan you're stuck on (T4/T6...). RebirthTime -1 = no auto-rebirth (you rebirth manually after the kill). Advanced Training leads because titans are killed with ADVENTURE stats; the tail goes into the Adventure/Power NGUs so a long run still leaves permanent progress. Gear auto-optimizes for Adventure (max Power/Toughness) + a Respawn item. Requires Manage Gear + Manage Energy/Magic ON.
Breakpoints._Injector: Not a challenge block - this is a deliberate single long rebirth. Turn Auto Rebirth OFF (or leave it; -1 overrides). Adventure: Combat ON, idle, target your best push zone. Wandoos is deliberately absent - it multiplies Fight Boss A/D only, and its levels die at rebirth, so it does nothing for the titan this profile exists to kill.
